development.note: Exploratory development, including two integration-test cases; not independent evidence.

selection: Among all-clear, zero-failed-clear development candidates with p95 time <= 1.05 baseline, choose lowest mean total virtual time. If none improve, retain baseline and report negative result.

holdout.freeze: Record chosen spec and source hashes before first holdout case. No further tuning after seeing holdout.

assessment: Report all attempts, failures, per-case paired mean savings and bootstrap CI, p95, worst regression, and pooled T/N. Only claim supported mean improvement if independent paired CI lower >0 and all runs clear successfully with no failed clears.
runtime: Only separate serial timing may support computer-time comparisons.
scope: Local synthetic simulator only. No official or formal tests. Old sealed/reserved partitions untouched.
